item.jaymoskingdoms.handgonne.hint: Hold use to load (gunpowder and a ball). Loaded, hold use to put the match to it. No good in the rain.
item.jaymoskingdoms.arquebus.hint: Hold use to load (gunpowder and a ball). Loaded, use it to fire. The match won't burn in the rain.
message.jaymoskingdoms.early_gun.wet: The match is wet. It won't fire.
message.jaymoskingdoms.early_gun.tier.ha: A handgonne's barrel is past you yet. (World tier: Borderlands)
message.jaymoskingdoms.early_gun.tier.ar: An arquebus's barrel is past you yet. (World tier: Wildlands)
You can't read an old piece's making yet. (Knowledge 2: an Ogre King)
item.jaymoskingdoms.worn_relic.lore: Dug out of old ground, worn through. Mend it with iron at an anvil, or take it apart at a Drafting Table.
